question: Determine $p$ and $q$ if $$\begin{bmatrix}2p+q & p-q \\ q & 3\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}8 & 1 \\ 2 & 3\end{bmatrix}.$$ Also verify that the remaining corresponding entry is equal.
explanation:
Comparison of corresponding entries
From the second row, first column, $q=2$. From the first row, second column, $$p-q=1$$
Hence, $p-2=1$, so $p=3$.
Verification using the remaining entry
$$2p+q=2(3)+2=8$$
This agrees with the corresponding entry of the second matrix.
Final values
$$p=3,\quad q=2$$
